monetization.noteEs: Compra única (~$45 USD por la Standard Edition) con ediciones superiores (Left Behind, Prepare for Escape, Edge of Darkness, Unheard Edition) que dan más stash, mejores items iniciales, trader rep extra y, en el caso de Unheard, acceso a PvE coop privado. Las ediciones premium son la principal queja de pay-to-win: stash más grande y starter gear funcionan como ventaja material directa. Tras el lanzamiento de 1.0 en noviembre 2025 sumó Steam y Epic, manteniendo la venta directa en el launcher de Battlestate Games. Sin season pass ni battle pass — el modelo de ingresos sigue siendo la compra de ediciones.
monetization.noteEn: One-time purchase (~$45 USD for the Standard Edition) with higher tiers (Left Behind, Prepare for Escape, Edge of Darkness, Unheard Edition) that grant larger stash, better starter items, extra trader rep, and — in Unheard's case — access to private PvE co-op. The premium editions are the main pay-to-win complaint: bigger stash and starter gear are direct material advantages. After the 1.0 launch in November 2025 it added Steam and Epic, while still selling through the Battlestate Games launcher. No season pass, no battle pass — the revenue model remains edition upgrades.
